title: Ami Maeshima Joins Cast, Performs Ending Theme for Rich Girl Caretaker Anime
content: The official website for the anime adaptation of author Yusaku Sakaishi and illustrator Sakura Miwabe 's Rich Girl Caretaker ( Saijo no Osewa ) light novel series announced on Friday that Ami Maeshima will play Karen Asahi.
author: ANN

title: Avatar: The Last Airbender Sequel in Danger Following The Legend of Aang Leak
content: Earlier this year, bending enthusiasts saw a major controversy unravel before their eyes as the long-awaited sequel film, The Legend of Aang: The Last Airbender , found its way online.
author: ComicBook

title: Black Clover Confirms Special Chapter After Manga Finale
content: After 11 years of serialization, Yuki Tabata’s hit action-fantasy manga, Black Clover , has finally reached its conclusion. The manga entered its Final Arc in 2022 before transitioning to Shueisha’s Jump GIGA magazine on a quarterly schedule due to Tabata’s health issues.
author: ComicBook

title: Eve Releases Witch Hat Atelier Opening Song Special Music Video
content: Witch Hat Atelier opening theme song artist Eve released a special music video of the opening song “Wind’s Anthem” on Friday. The music video consists of scenes from the anime. Witch Hat Atelier is currently available to watch on Netflix and Crunchyroll. Ayumu Watanabe is directing the anime at BUG FILMS.
author: Anime Corner

title: 5 Years Later, The Most Anticipated Sports Anime’s Sequel Hasn’t Shared Any Updates
content: It’s often difficult for original anime series to gain recognition among viewers as compared to those shows based on a manga or a light novel. Usually, series that already have a manga or a light novel also have a fanbase that is looking forward to an anime adaptation.
author: ComicBook

title: Rich Girl Caretaker Reveals Ending Theme Song
content: Rich Girl Caretaker anime revealed its ending theme song titled “Kanpeki janai watashi” by Ami Maeshima. Additionally, Maeshima will also join the cast as Karen Asahi. The anime is slated to premiere on July 4.
author: Anime Corner

title: The Amazing Digital Circus Defeats Number One Movie at The Box Office
content: Fathom Entertainment has helped Glitch Productions do what many thought was impossible, bringing a beloved web series to the silver screen. The Amazing Digital Circus is one of the biggest independent YouTube animations of all time, garnering tens of millions of views since its debut in 2023.
author: ComicBook

title: MAPPA to Reveal Chainsaw Man Update and New Projects During 15th Anniversary Presentation
content: Animation studio MAPPA has announced a special 15th anniversary lineup presentation, set to stream on its official YouTube channel on June 19. The event will feature updates on several of the studio’s major projects, alongside the reveal of entirely new ones.
author: Anime Corner

title: Love Unseen Beneath the Clear Night Sky Anime Unveils Key Visual
content: Love Unseen Beneath the Clear Night Sky anime unveiled a key visual ahead of its July 2026 premiere. The visual features the main characters Koharu Fuyutsuki and Kakeru Sorano. title: Crunchyroll Is Finally Streaming Jujutsu Kaisen’s Latest Film
content: The highly anticipated Jujutsu Kaisen Season 4 has yet to share any details on its release date. The anime will continue to adapt the intense Culling Game Arc, where the Jujutsu sorcerers are forced to participate in a deathly battle royale.
